audit.why: The autoreset tell is listed in missingInteractions for this exact matchup, and the kit file flags Tumble as autoReset. Reacting to the dash is reacting one beat too late.
audit.corrected: whys[1] now names Tumble as an auto reset and keys the root to her attack wind-up.
